info.title: localizationkit — keep .resw resources, project items and local Visual Studio state in sync.
info.description: Command line tool for LocalizationKit: add a culture, sync the local Visual Studio files, and validate resources.

commands.name: add-culture
commands.description: scaffold a language end to end

options.name: --project
options.description: the .csproj to act on (discovered when omitted)

options.name: --resources-path
options.description: folder holding culture subfolders (default: Strings)

options.name: --file-name
options.description: resource file name (default: Resources.resw)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: print what would change, write nothing

options.name: --culture
options.description: export and import: which culture is being translated

options.name: --format
options.description:
export and import: inferred from the file name when omitted
validate only: msbuild emits diagnostics MSBuild re-logs

options.name: --out
options.description: export only: write to a file instead of standard output

options.name: --unused
options.description: validate only: also list keys the source never mentions

options.name: --warnings-as-errors
options.description:
validate: exit non-zero on warnings too
Exit codes: 0 success, 1 failure, 2 usage error.

options.name: --prune
options.description: also remove Resource Explorer columns for cultures that are gone

options.name: --empty
options.description: add-culture: do not copy keys from the default culture

commands.name: export
commands.description: write a PO or XLIFF file for a translator

commands.name: import
commands.description: take a translated file back in

commands.name: info
commands.description: show what was discovered

commands.name: sync-ide
commands.description: reconcile the gitignored IDE files

commands.name: validate
commands.description: check keys, messages and coverage
